title: 增长与变现
markdown:
# 增长与变现

## 概述

本章聚焦增长与变现场景，分为增长指标、变现模式、增长策略、LTV 与 ROI 四个部分。它帮助读者用英语描述用户增长、商业变现和投入产出的相关概念，重点在指标词汇和模式的准确表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合业务讨论和汇报。建议把增长指标与变现、ROI 类术语结合学习，理解增长与收益之间的关系。

## 增长指标

| 词汇                       | 词性  | 含义       | 常用搭配                           |
| -------------------------- | ----- | ---------- | ---------------------------------- |
| DAU (Daily Active Users)   | n.    | 日活跃用户 | DAU growth, track DAU              |
| MAU (Monthly Active Users) | n.    | 月活跃用户 | MAU target, MAU increase           |
| retention                  | n.    | 留存       | Day-1 retention, retention curve   |
| churn                      | n./v. | 流失       | churn rate, reduce churn           |
| acquisition                | n.    | 获客       | user acquisition, acquisition cost |
| activation                 | n.    | 激活       | user activation, activation rate   |

### 听说例句

> A: What's our Day-1 retention rate? B: 45%. It's above the industry benchmark, but our Day-7 churn is still too high.

> A: How much are we spending on user acquisition? B: About $2.50 per new user. We need to focus on activation to make sure they stick.

### 写作表达

- DAU has grown 30% quarter-over-quarter, driven by improved onboarding and higher activation rates.
- Reducing Day-7 churn by 10% is projected to increase MAU by approximately 200,000 users.

---

## 变现模式

| 词汇            | 词性    | 含义       | 常用搭配                                 |
| --------------- | ------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| monetize        | v.      | 变现       | monetize content, monetization strategy  |
| subscription    | n.      | 订阅       | subscription model, premium subscription |
| in-app purchase | n.      | 应用内购买 | in-app purchase revenue, IAP             |
| ad revenue      | n.      | 广告收入   | ad revenue share, generate ad revenue    |
| freemium        | adj./n. | 免费增值   | freemium model, freemium tier            |
| paywall         | n.      | 付费墙     | behind a paywall, introduce a paywall    |

### 听说例句

> A: How are we monetizing the creator platform? B: Through a combination of ad revenue sharing and in-app purchases. We're also testing a premium subscription.

> A: Should we put this feature behind a paywall? B: Not yet. Let's keep the freemium model and use it to drive adoption first.

### 写作表达

- The freemium model has proven effective in driving user acquisition while generating revenue through premium subscriptions.
- In-app purchase revenue surpassed ad revenue for the first time in Q3, indicating a shift in monetization dynamics.

---

## 增长策略

| 词汇               | 词性 | 含义         | 常用搭配                               |
| ------------------ | ---- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| growth hack        | n.   | 增长黑客     | growth hacking, growth experiment      |
| referral           | n.   | 推荐         | referral program, referral bonus       |
| viral loop         | n.   | 病毒循环     | create a viral loop, viral coefficient |
| product-led growth | n.   | 产品驱动增长 | PLG strategy, product-led approach     |
| cohort             | n.   | 群组         | cohort analysis, user cohort           |
| experiment         | n.   | 实验         | run an experiment, experiment results  |

### 听说例句

> A: Are we running any growth experiments this sprint? B: Yes, we're testing a referral program with a viral loop. Each invite gives both users a reward.

> A: Should we adopt a product-led growth strategy? B: It makes sense for our B2B SaaS product. Let me run a cohort analysis to see where users convert.

### 写作表达

- The referral program created a powerful viral loop, with each active user inviting an average of 2.3 new users.
- Cohort analysis revealed that users who complete onboarding within 24 hours have 3x higher lifetime value.

---

## LTV与ROI

| 词汇                            | 词性    | 含义         | 常用搭配                                     |
| ------------------------------- | ------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| LTV (Lifetime Value)            | n.      | 用户终身价值 | calculate LTV, LTV:CAC ratio                 |
| CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) | n.      | 获客成本     | reduce CAC, CAC payback period               |
| ROI (Return on Investment)      | n.      | 投资回报率   | positive ROI, measure ROI                    |
| payback period                  | n.      | 回收期       | CAC payback, shorten payback period          |
| unit economics                  | n.      | 单位经济     | healthy unit economics, unit economics model |
| breakeven                       | n./adj. | 盈亏平衡     | reach breakeven, breakeven point             |

### 听说例句

> A: What's our current LTV:CAC ratio? B: 3.5:1. That's healthy. The CAC payback period is under 6 months.

> A: When do we expect to reach breakeven on this market? B: Based on current unit economics, we should hit breakeven by Q2 next year.

### 写作表达

- A healthy LTV:CAC ratio of 3:1 or above indicates sustainable unit economics and efficient customer acquisition.
- The company is on track to reach breakeven in the Southeast Asian market by the end of the fiscal year.
